-- SetupConfig: { "Requires": [ "Dawk.vProductOldestVersion" ] } alter view Dawk.vProductMonthlySalesEstimation as SELECT p.ASIN, p.ProductId, IIF(pold.ProductId is not null and pold.ReviewRatingCount > p.ReviewRatingCount, 'FromHistory', 'FromDate') as EstimationType, IIF( -- if we find a product version eligible for estimation from history we compute monthly sales from it pold.ProductId is not null -- when Amazon regulates reviews we can have negative offsets, in this case we estimate using product publication date and pold.ReviewRatingCount < p.ReviewRatingCount, cast(round(((p.ReviewRatingCount - pold.ReviewRatingCount) * 30 / datediff(day, pold.ValidFrom, p.ValidFrom) / 0.07) * ( -- using average price from this version date to now select avg(Price) as AvgPrice from Dawk.tProduct for system_time all historic where ProductId = p.ProductId and ValidFrom >= pold.ValidFrom group by ProductId ), 0) as int), -- if no eligible product version: we use the product publication date to compute an average review count per month, cast(round(p.ReviewRatingCount * 30 / datediff(day, p.ProductAgeDate, getutcdate()) / 0.07 * ( -- using average price from all history select avg(Price) as AvgPrice from Dawk.tProduct for system_time all where ProductId = p.ProductId group by ProductId ), 0) as int) ) as EstimatedMonthlySales
FROM Dawk.tProduct p
-- join on product history looking for an aligible product version nearest from 30 days ago where review count was different from current version (limited between 15 to 45 days ago) left outer join ( select p.ProductId, ph.ReviewRatingCount, ph.ValidFrom from Dawk.tProduct p outer apply ( select top(1) *, abs(datediff(day, ph.ValidFrom, DATEADD(day, -30, GETUTCDATE()))) as TimeDistance from Dawk.tProductHistory ph where p.ProductId = ph.ProductId and ph.ValidFrom < p.ValidFrom and ph.ValidFrom >= DATEADD(day, -45, GETUTCDATE()) and ph.ValidFrom <= DATEADD(day, -15, GETUTCDATE()) and p.ReviewRatingCount <> ph.ReviewRatingCount order by TimeDistance asc ) as ph
) pold on pold.ProductId = p.ProductId
Test.Description: Many thanks to Isaac for this marvellous view.

Test.Text: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.SeattleOnly AS SELECT p.LastName, p.FirstName, e.JobTitle, a.City, sp.StateProvinceCode FROM HumanResources.Employee e INNER JOIN Person.Person p ON p.BusinessEntityID = e.BusinessEntityID INNER JOIN Person.BusinessEntityAddress bea ON bea.BusinessEntityID = e.BusinessEntityID INNER JOIN Person.Address a ON a.AddressID = bea.AddressID INNER JOIN Person.StateProvince sp ON sp.StateProvinceID = a.StateProvinceID WHERE a.City = 'Seattle' WITH CHECK OPTION ;
Test.Description: A view with the WITH CHECK OPTION

From.SelectFrom: FROM HumanResources.Employee e INNER JOIN Person.Person p ON p.BusinessEntityID=e.BusinessEntityID INNER JOIN Person.BusinessEntityAddress bea ON bea.BusinessEntityID=e.BusinessEntityID INNER JOIN Person.Address a ON a.AddressID=bea.AddressID INNER JOIN Person.StateProvince sp ON sp.StateProvinceID=a.StateProvinceID

Test.Text: -- SetupConfig: {} create view EVC.vGroupWithTwoExclusiveSubGroups as with groups( PeriodId, PeriodName, GroupId, GroupName, Group1Id, Group1Name, Group2Id, Group2Name ) as (select p.PeriodId, pG.GroupName, main.GroupId, main.GroupName, Group1Id = g1.GroupId, Group1Name = g1.GroupName, Group2Id = g2.GroupId, Group2Name = g2.GroupName from EV.tPeriod p cross join EVC.tGroupWithTwoSubGroups conf inner join CK.tGroup pG on pG.GroupId = p.PeriodId inner join CK.tGroup main on main.ZoneId = p.PeriodId and main.GroupName = conf.MainGroupName inner join CK.tGroup g1 on g1.ZoneId = p.PeriodId and g1.GroupName = conf.SubGroupName1 inner join CK.tGroup g2 on g2.ZoneId = p.PeriodId and g2.GroupName = conf.SubGroupName2 where p.PeriodId > 0), inMainAndNotInSub( Cost, UserId, UserName, PeriodId, PeriodName, GroupId, GroupName, Group1Id, Group1Name, Group2Id, Group2Name ) as (select conf.CostMainAndNotInSub, gU.UserId, gU.UserName, g.* from groups g inner join CK.tActorProfile gA on gA.GroupId = g.GroupId inner join CK.tUser gU on gU.UserId = gA.ActorId inner join EVC.tGroupWithTwoSubGroups conf on conf.MainGroupName = g.GroupName and conf.SubGroupName1 = g.Group1Name and conf.SubGroupName2 = g.Group2Name where gA.ActorId not in (select ActorId from CK.tActorProfile where GroupId = g.Group1Id or GroupId = g.Group2Id)), inSub1AndNotInMain( Cost, UserId, UserName, PeriodId, PeriodName, GroupId, GroupName, SubGroupId, SubGroup1Name ) as (select distinct 100, gU.UserId, gU.UserName, g.PeriodId, g.PeriodName, g.GroupId, g.GroupName, g.Group1Id, g.Group1Name from groups g inner join CK.tActorProfile gA on gA.GroupId = g.Group1Id inner join CK.tUser gU on gU.UserId = gA.ActorId where gA.ActorId not in (select ActorId from CK.tActorProfile where GroupId = g.GroupId )), inSub2AndNotInMain( Cost, UserId, UserName, PeriodId, PeriodName, GroupId, GroupName, SubGroupId, SubGroup1Name ) as (select distinct 100, gU.UserId, gU.UserName, g.PeriodId, g.PeriodName, g.GroupId, g.GroupName, g.Group2Id, g.Group2Name from groups g inner join CK.tActorProfile gA on gA.GroupId = g.Group2Id inner join CK.tUser gU on gU.UserId = gA.ActorId where gA.ActorId not in (select ActorId from CK.tActorProfile where GroupId = g.GroupId )), inBothSub( Cost, UserId, UserName, PeriodId, PeriodName, Group1Id, Group1Name, Group2Id, Group2Name ) as (select 100, gU.UserId, gU.UserName, g.PeriodId, g.PeriodName, g.Group1Id, g.Group1Name, g.Group2Id, g.Group2Name from groups g inner join CK.tActorProfile gIL on gIL.GroupId = g.Group1Id inner join CK.tActorProfile gSR on gSR.GroupId = g.Group2Id inner join CK.tUser gU on gU.UserId = gSR.ActorId where gSR.ActorId = gIL.ActorId) select * from (select VName='InMainAndNotInSub', Detail = (select * from inMainAndNotInSub for JSON AUTO) union all select VName='InSubAndNotInMain', Detail = (select * from inSub1AndNotInMain for JSON AUTO) union all select VName='InSubAndNotInMain', Detail = (select * from inSub2AndNotInMain for JSON AUTO) union all select VName='InBothSub', Detail = (select * from inBothSub for JSON AUTO)) result where result.Detail is not null;
